title: Testing Types & Levels
description: Рівні тестування (unit, integration, system, acceptance), функціональне й нефункціональне тестування, black/white/grey box, статичне тестування, smoke/sanity/regression/re-testing, дослідницьке тестування і піраміда тестів.
goals: Choose the right test level for a check and explain who usually does it
Tell functional from non-functional requirements and make vague ones measurable
Name the main non-functional testing types and what each one finds
Explain black-box, white-box and grey-box approaches
Review a requirement and find ambiguities (static testing)
Decide between smoke, sanity, regression and re-testing in real situations
Write a charter for an exploratory testing session
Use the test pyramid to decide what to automate and at which level
